item.title: mini-mcmc — a lightweight Rust library for MCMC
item.description: This post introduces mini-mcmc, a compact Rust library for running modern MCMC algorithms—like NUTS, HMC, Metropolis–Hastings, and Gibbs—with automatic differentiation, parallel chains, and optional GPU acceleration.
